name: BUY.BOX Widget
author: Platforma BUY.BOX

sections.description:
Wtyczka umożliwia integrację Twojej witryny z Platformą BUY.BOX, pozwalając na szybkie i łatwe dodawanie widżetów BUY.BOX do treści.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

  1. BUY.BOX Widget Service (widget.buybox.click)

    • Purpose: Loads the BUY.BOX widget interface and functionality
    • Data sent: None
    • When: When a widget is displayed on your site
    • Terms of Service: https://getbuybox.com/regulamin/
    • Privacy Policy: https://getbuybox.com/polityka-prywatnosci/

  2. BUY.BOX API Service (api.buybox.click)

    • Purpose: Retrieves widget configurations and settings
    • Data sent: API token (stored in WordPress options)
    • When: When configuring widgets in the admin panel
    • Terms of Service: https://getbuybox.com/regulamin/
    • Privacy Policy: https://getbuybox.com/polityka-prywatnosci/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/buybox-widget directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->BUY.BOX screen to configure the plugin
  4. Place the shortcode [buybox-widget] in your posts or pages
sections.faq:
How do I get an API token?

You can get your API token by registering at getbuybox.com.
